screening_decisions.reason: Prospective randomized clinical studies comparing biocompatible polyacrylonitrile membranes (BCM) with bioincompatible cuprophane membranes (BICM) in 72 patients with ARF requiring hemodialysis. Meets all selection criteria.
Observational study examining hemodialysis effects on renal recovery. Does not compare BCM vs BICM membranes. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Prospective observational study assessing prognostic factors in ARF due to sepsis. While it mentions membrane type in analysis, it is not a randomized trial comparing BCM vs BICM.
Prospective randomized study comparing cuprophane (BICM) with polyacrylonitrile (BCM) membranes in 52 patients with ARF requiring hemodialysis. Meets all selection criteria.

Randomized trial but compares two synthetic membranes (both BCM) - high-permeability vs conventional hemofiltration. Does not compare BCM vs BICM. Also uses hemofiltration, not intermittent hemodialysis.
Meta-analysis of myocardial infarction trials. Wrong topic - not about ARF or dialysis membranes.
Observational study comparing two synthetic membranes (polyamide vs polyacrylonitrile, both BCM). Uses hemofiltration, not intermittent hemodialysis. Not a randomized trial.
Randomized trial but compares cellulose acetate (modified cellulose, biocompatible) with polysulfone (synthetic, biocompatible). Both are BCM, not BCM vs BICM comparison.
Meta-analysis of existing trials, not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Methodological paper about meta-analysis techniques. Not a clinical trial about ARF or dialysis membranes.
Study comparing biocompatible vs bioincompatible membranes in 57 patients with ARF requiring hemodialysis. Appears to be a randomized or quasi-randomized trial comparing BCM vs BICM.
Observational prognostic study using regression analysis. Does not compare dialysis membranes. Not a randomized trial.
Randomized trial but compares two synthetic membranes (PAN vs polysulfone, both BCM). Uses continuous venovenous dialysis, not intermittent hemodialysis.
Review article summarizing clinical trials. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Review article discussing meta-analyses. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Abstract appears corrupted/incomplete (shows rat study references). Insufficient information to determine if it meets selection criteria.
Study about publication bias in oncology trials. Wrong topic - not about ARF or dialysis membranes.
Review article about dialysate purity. Does not compare BCM vs BICM membranes in a randomized trial.
Study of pretransplantation dialysis in kidney transplant patients. Population is transplant recipients, not ARF patients requiring hemodialysis as primary treatment.
Observational registry study analyzing risk factors. Does not compare BCM vs BICM membranes. Not a randomized trial.
Review article discussing dialysis variables. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Crossover study comparing cellulose acetate (modified cellulose, biocompatible) with polysulfone (synthetic, biocompatible). Both are BCM, not BCM vs BICM comparison.
Randomized trial but compares cellulose diacetate (modified cellulose, biocompatible) with polysulfone (synthetic, biocompatible). Both are BCM, not BCM vs BICM comparison.
Review article discussing membrane biocompatibility. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Randomized trial but compares two synthetic membranes (both BCM) - low-flux vs high-flux polysulfone/polyacrylonitrile. Does not compare BCM vs BICM.
Observational study using USRDS data on chronic hemodialysis patients (dialysis for at least 1 year). Not ARF patients, not a randomized trial.

Prospective randomized multicentre trial comparing bioincompatible Cuprophan (BICM) with polymethyl-methacrylate (BCM) membranes in 180 patients with ARF requiring dialysis. Meets all selection criteria.
Meta-analysis of ACE inhibitor trials in nondiabetic renal disease. Wrong topic - not about dialysis membranes or ARF.
Review article about renal replacement therapies. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Randomized trial comparing dialysis modalities (EDD vs continuous hemodialysis), not membrane types (BCM vs BICM).

Prospective multicenter study with alternating assignment (quasi-randomized) comparing biocompatible membranes (BCM) with bioincompatible cellulosic membranes (BICM) in 153 patients with ARF requiring dialysis. Meets all selection criteria.
Analysis of observational data from French Prospective Multicenter Study. Centers followed their usual practice - not a randomized trial comparing BCM vs BICM.
Randomized trial but compares two synthetic membranes (both BCM) - high permeability vs conventional hemofiltration. Uses hemofiltration, not intermittent hemodialysis.
Discussion/debate article about pathophysiology of ARF. Not a clinical trial about dialysis membranes.
